title: Double-nailed vertical weatherboards on a house in a very high wind zone: code compliance certificate refused
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE Chief Executive determination; Building Act 2004; comparative only, not Alberta)
code_edition: NZ Building Code, First Schedule, Building Regulations 1992 (cited); edition not stated

facts.text: A three-bedroom detached house, two storeys in part, on a steeply sloping excavated site in a very high wind zone; moderately complex; moderate to high weathertightness risk.
Construction is light timber frame with some engineered steel elements; the vertical weatherboards are installed over a cavity but are double-nailed.
Figure 1 is a weatherboard installation diagram (not to scale).
The matter is compliance of the weatherboard cladding with E2 and B2; the authority refused the code compliance certificate because of the double nailing.
